name: FastMCP
description: Pythonic framework for building MCP servers and clients.
descriptionZh: 用于构建 MCP 服务器与客户端的 Pythonic 框架。
keyFact: FastMCP is an Apache-2.0 Python framework for building MCP servers and clients, created by Prefect CEO Jeremiah Lowin; FastMCP 1.0 was incorporated into the official MCP Python SDK in 2024, and the project moved from jlowin/fastmcp to the PrefectHQ organization.
keyFactZh: FastMCP 是 Apache-2.0 的 Python 框架，用于构建 MCP 服务器与客户端，由 Prefect CEO Jeremiah Lowin 创建；FastMCP 1.0 于 2024 年被并入官方 MCP Python SDK，仓库也已从 jlowin/fastmcp 迁移至 PrefectHQ 组织。
